verdict.rationale: Decagon's own docs say the product includes guardrails that technical teams control. Nothing describes what those guardrails do, and testing (Simulations), Watchtower monitoring and knowledge-gap detection are adjacent features that earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented grounding that stops the agent from inventing policies, prices or promises, a documented safe-decline or fallback for off-knowledge questions, details of how the guardrails are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, guardrails stop the agent from inventing policies, prices, or promises — off-knowledge questions get a safe decline, not a guess
